marketAdmin.listingsLead: Knowledge listings and experts asking to go public: complete, free of banned content (stock tips, target prices, ratings, promised returns), with the license the category needs. Only approved ones go up.
marketAdmin.qualificationsLead: Publishers' identity material and licenses. Photos are only viewed here and deleted a year after review.
marketAdmin.reportsLead: Upheld means taken down: buyers keep their knowledge; experts can no longer be asked, running tasks finish.
marketAdmin.rulesLead: Each change is a new version; older ones are kept. The web shows the latest.
marketAdmin.tradesLead: This period records prices and trades; no real payment.
marketAdmin.rulesVersion: Current version {version} (0 is the platform's first draft)
marketAdmin.tradeCopying: Not fully copied (a retry by the buyer resumes it)
